description: Engine-agnostic map/level definition generated by the Kodr model. Compile it into working scenes for Roblox (Luau), Unity (C#), or Godot (GDScript) with model/tools/compile_map.py.

fields.name: string, human readable level name
fields.theme: string, e.g. pirate, dungeon, space, forest
fields.tile_scale: number, world units per grid cell (default 4)
fields.size: [width, depth] grid dimensions of the level
fields.heightmap: list of rows equal to depth; each row a string of characters. Codes: . empty floor, # solid wall, T tree, R rock, W water, L lava, D door, C chest, P enemy spawn, S player/team spawn, B bridge, H hazard, G goal/exit, XX special (see objects)
fields.terrain: optional: {type: flat|hills, seed, height_noise} tuning for generated elevation
fields.objects: array of explicit placed objects {type, name, position:[x,y,z], rotation:[rx,ry,rz], scale:[sx,sy,sz], properties:{...}}
fields.design_notes: array of strings explaining layout intent, chokepoints, pacing
